blocks.raw: # Getting Started
blocks.text: Getting Started

blocks.raw: How to create your first dataflow in Connect+ — selecting a template, configuring blocks, and running the flow.
blocks.text: How to create your first dataflow in Connect+ — selecting a template, configuring blocks, and running the flow.

blocks.raw: Connect+ is Capillary's data integration platform. It lets you build dataflows that read data from a source, transform it, and send it to a destination. This page walks you through everything you need before you begin and shows you how to create and run your first dataflow.
blocks.text: Connect+ is Capillary's data integration platform. It lets you build dataflows that read data from a source, transform it, and send it to a destination. This page walks you through everything you need before you begin and shows you how to create and run your first dataflow.

blocks.raw: ## Understand the flow
blocks.text: Understand the flow

blocks.raw: Every dataflow in Connect+ follows the same lifecycle. Understanding this before you start saves time.
blocks.text: Every dataflow in Connect+ follows the same lifecycle. Understanding this before you start saves time.

blocks.raw:
1. Save your connection details in Extension Configurations in Dev Console. This includes FTP hostnames, folder paths, passwords, Secret Key, Databricks Token, and Client Secret.
2. Create a dataflow in Draft state, either from a template or from scratch on the canvas.
3. Configure the blocks according to your requirements.
4. Save the dataflow and send it for approval.
5. A reviewer approves it.
6. Make the approved dataflow live.
7. Monitor accuracy and errors from the Platform Metrics tab in Dev Console.

blocks.raw: ## Step 1: Create configurations in Extension Configurations
blocks.text: Step 1: Create configurations in Extension Configurations

blocks.raw: [Extension Configurations](https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/extension-configuration) is a secure store in Dev Console where you save the connection details and credentials that your dataflow blocks need. Set this up before you create a dataflow so the values are available to select when you configure each block.
blocks.text: Extension Configurations is a secure store in Dev Console where you save the connection details and credentials that your dataflow blocks need. Set this up before you create a dataflow so the values are available to select when you configure each block.

blocks.raw: To create a new configuration, refer to the documentation on **[Extension Configuration](https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/extension-configuration)s**
blocks.text: To create a new configuration, refer to the documentation on Extension Configurations

blocks.raw: Enable **isSecret** for the following fields: **Password**, **Secret Key**, **dataBricksToken**, and **Client Secret**. Once marked as secret, the value cannot be unmasked. If these fields are not marked as isSecret, the configuration name does not appear in the drop-down when you configure the block.

blocks.raw: ## Step 2: Open Connect+
blocks.text: Step 2: Open Connect+

blocks.raw:
1. Open Connect+ using your cluster URL.
   * EU: <https://eu.intouch.capillarytech.com/extensions/connectplus/ui>
   * India: <https://intouch.capillary.co.in/extensions/connectplus/ui>
   * APAC2: <https://apac2.intouch.capillarytech.com/extensions/connectplus/ui>
   * SG: <https://sgcrm.cc.capillarytech.com/extensions/connectplus/ui>
   * US: <https://north-america.intouch.capillarytech.com/extensions/connectplus/ui>
2. From the dropdown at the top of the page, select your organization.

blocks.raw: You are now on the Connect+ homepage. It lists all dataflows in your workspace along with their status, version, and accuracy percentage.

blocks.raw: ## Step 3: Create your first dataflow
blocks.text: Step 3: Create your first dataflow

blocks.raw: On the Connect+ homepage, click **Create new dataflow**. Enter a name, optionally add tags, enter notification email addresses, and click **Done**. The dataflow creator receives notifications by default.
blocks.text: On the Connect+ homepage, click Create new dataflow. Enter a name, optionally add tags, enter notification email addresses, and click Done. The dataflow creator receives notifications by default.

blocks.raw: ## Step 4: Compose the dataflow
blocks.text: Step 4: Compose the dataflow

blocks.raw: Open the dataflow and click version v1. Add [blocks](https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/connect-building-block-configuration) to the canvas to define how data is sourced, transformed, and delivered. Configure each block's fields, connect the blocks in sequence, and click **Save**.

blocks.raw: For block configuration details, see [Creating and managing Connect+ dataflows](https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/creating-and-managing-connect-dataflows).

blocks.raw: ## Step 5: Save and send for approval
blocks.text: Step 5: Save and send for approval

blocks.raw: Click **Send for approval** to submit the dataflow for review. It moves to Awaiting approval state and is locked for editing until an Admin approves it.
blocks.text: Click Send for approval to submit the dataflow for review. It moves to Awaiting approval state and is locked for editing until an Admin approves it.

blocks.raw: ## Step 6: Make the dataflow live
blocks.text: Step 6: Make the dataflow live

blocks.raw: Once the dataflow is approved, its state changes to Approved. Open the dataflow and click **Make live**.
blocks.text: Once the dataflow is approved, its state changes to Approved. Open the dataflow and click Make live.

blocks.raw: Your dataflow is now live and will process data according to the schedule you configured.

blocks.raw: ## Step 7: Monitor the results
blocks.text: Step 7: Monitor the results

blocks.raw: After the first run, check your dataflow performance from the **Platform Metrics** tab in Dev Console. To receive notifications when issues occur, set up alerts from **[Alert Management](https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/alert-management)**. For more information, see [Connect+ performance in Dev Console](https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/platform-metrics#connect-platform-metrics).
